notes: Taken from the Board of Elections' 46-day election notice, which lists every contest and issue with the precincts that vote on it and gives the issues' ballot wording.

Candidates are listed alphabetically by last name, not in ballot order: Ohio rotates the order of names from precinct to precinct. Certified write-in candidates are not printed on the ballot and are not listed.

"Where you live" uses the state voter file: a district or school levy is shown for a city, village or township when any of its voters live in that district. Your exact ballot depends on your precinct.
The Board's notice does not give local issue numbers; see your sample ballot for them.

contests.office: Judge of the Court of Appeals

issues.title: Tax levy (renewal): Providing emergency medical service
issues.area: Grover Hill Village (precinct 11/2 Latty Twp. & Grover Hill)

levy.estimate: $880 a year; $5 for each $100,000 of the county auditor's market value

issues.text: A renewal of a tax for the benefit of Grover Hill Village for the purpose of providing emergency medical service, that the county auditor estimates will collect $880 annually, at a rate not exceeding 0.5 mill for each $1 of taxable value, which amounts to $5 for each $100,000 of the county auditor's market value, for 5 years, commencing in 2026, first due in calendar year 2027.

issues.title: Municipal income tax: 0.10% additional, 5 years, for streets
issues.text: Shall the Ordinance providing for an additional 0.10 per cent levy on income, for 5 years, for the purpose of street construction, reconstruction, repair, maintenance, and related street infrastructure improvements be passed?

issues.title: Municipal income tax: 0.10% additional, 5 years, for the village swimming pool
issues.note: The Village of Paulding has two separate 0.10% income tax questions on this ballot (streets and swimming pool).
issues.text: Shall the Ordinance providing for an additional 0.10 per cent levy on income, for 5 years, for the purpose of acquiring, constructing, improving, repairing, operating, maintaining, and equipping the village swimming pool and related facilities be passed?
